messages:
Maria: Quick sync for SecureKey handover tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: SCIM attribute mapping, BYOK/KMS workflow, HSM attestation, marketplace blurb + joint announcement embargo. Need owners for each item. @Aj can you confirm SCIM attributes? :calendar:

Aj: I can own SCIM. Two open items: do they need group sync? and a custom attr `department_id` mapping. We support mapping expressions — sample: `user.customFields.department => department`. Need sample SCIM payload from partner to lock mapping.

Kevin: Security will own BYOK/KMS and HSM validation. We need partner's PKCS#8 public key + cert chain and allowed wrapping algos (RSA-OAEP preferred). Also need vendor attestation for HSM — are they FIPS 140-2/3 certified? If not, we need mitigation notes.

Sam: Legal — we need embargo date and draft co-announcement by Tue EOD. Also confirm if partner logo + quotes allowed in marketplace listing.

deploy-bot (ci): Reminder: onboarding checklist created at https://internal/onboard/securekey-idp — please update status fields (SCIM/KMS/HSM/Legal).

Maria: Timeline idea: canary on Dedicated next week, marketplace listing ~2 weeks after successful canary. @Aj @Kevin please post any blockers by EOD today so we can adjust timeline.

Aj: Quick status: draft SCIM mapping done, but need a SAML assertion example to validate nameID formats and email attrs. Also ask partner to support SCIM filter for groups (`?filter=members eq \"user@example.com\"`) so we can backfill.

Kevin: Confirmed BYOK wrap algo = RSA-OAEP acceptable. Waiting on partner HSM attestation doc. Rotation policy: must support key rotation at least every 90 days or an org-level policy we can reference. Flag: if partner uses BYOK + HSM, we need to test key import flow in staging.

Sam: Legal OK with our standard co-announcement template but need marketing copy and final approval. Marketing will ping Lina for draft. Also add NDA amendment for SOC2 addendum if they want SOC2 derivative language.

Maria: Noted. I'll centralize artifacts in /projects/partners/securekey and create a follow-up card in the partnership board. @Kevin, can you estimate how long SOC2 addendum drafting takes? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Kevin: SOC2 addendum draft ~3 business days after partner signs the NDA. We'll prepare a skeleton now so it's ready once they sign.

Aj: Testing note — we'll give partner ephemeral staging creds. Example curl to test SCIM create: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/Users -d '{"userName":"jdoe","emails":[{"value":"jdoe@example.com"}]}'`

Maria: Great — closing loop for now. I'll set the follow-up thread after tomorrow's 10am PT call with the partner. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
